scope: Integer scores, Q24 coefficients, record/page ID ordering, query epochs, and an internal ordered 16×32 B receive FIFO. Continuous and seeded randomized input/output pressure use the same implementation parameters.

wait_buckets.blocked_record_slot_cycles: a buffered beat cannot acquire its record slot or both straddling banks
wait_buckets.blocked_result_credit_cycles: the next prepared record cannot start its first dot because every output credit is held
wait_buckets.waited_coefficient_cycles: the next assembled record is at the dot head and awaits its coefficient writes

wait_interpretation: The ingress stall and dot stall can overlap. The two dot-head stall counters are exclusive.
